paragraphs: Rabbi Pinchas, son of Rabbi Avin.

Hyman cites Bamidbar Rabbah 11:3 for his report in Rabbi Chanin’s name. Hyman reports that the statement recurs in Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, page 45, where Rabbi Pinchas reports Rabbi Avin. Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 9:1 reads Rabbi Pinchas bei Rabbi Bun; Hyman suggests that it should read “in the name of Rabbi Bun.”

notes.text: The reading bei Rabbi Bun and the proposed “in the name of Rabbi Bun” describe different relationships; Hyman’s proposal is retained as a proposal.
At the corresponding locus in the consulted Bamidbar Rabbah, Rabbi Pinchas son of Rabbi Avin is followed by “Rabbi Chanin said.” Hyman understands the words as an attribution to Rabbi Chanin.
